title: Minus one, then AND
hook: Subtract 1 from x, then AND the two. Which bits of x survive?

knows: bit masks keep or clear named bits (mask-the-flags)
doesNotKnow: that x & (x - 1) removes exactly the lowest set bit, so it counts ones and tests powers of two

misconception: Subtracting 1 changes only the last digit, as in decimal.
objective: The learner can explain that x - 1 turns the lowest 1 bit into 0 and the zeros below it into 1s, so x & (x - 1) clears exactly that bit; repeating it until 0 counts the 1 bits (10110 takes 3), and x > 0 is a power of two exactly when one repeat gives 0.

claims.text: Repeating x = x & (x - 1) on 10110 gives 10100, then 10000, then 0: 3 repeats, one per 1 bit.
claims.source: Demo.tsx repeatsToZero(0b10110) and the stage's apply(); builder re-ran in Node (2026-10-14): 10110 -> 10100 -> 10000 -> 0. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 21): verified. Node: 10110 -> 10100 -> 10000 -> 0, 3 repeats.

claims.text: Subtracting 1 turns the lowest 1 bit into 0 and every 0 below it into 1 (10110 - 1 = 10101), so the AND keeps only the bits the two share and clears exactly that one bit.
claims.source: Write x = w1 0...0 (k trailing zeros). Then x - 1 = w0 1...1: bits above the lowest 1 are unchanged, so x & (x - 1) = w0 0...0. Node: (22 - 1).toString(2) = '10101'. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 21): verified. Derivation re-checked; (22-1).toString(2) = 10101.
Builder's Node run, 2026-10-14 (Demo.tsx R255). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 21): verified. repeatsToZero(255) = 8.

claims.text: If one repeat gives 0, x was a power of two: 2^30 takes 1 repeat, while shifting right one place at a time needs 31 shifts to reach 0.
claims.source: Builder's Node run, 2026-10-14: repeatsToZero(2^30) = 1; shifting 2^30 right until 0 takes 31 shifts (bit 30 must pass 30 places, then one more to drop off). Derivation for the test: x > 0 has exactly one 1 bit iff clearing the lowest leaves 0. The repeat-count loop is Kernighan and Ritchie, The C Programming Language (2nd ed.), exercise 2-9 (citation from the brief: check before verifying). | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 21): verified. repeatsToZero(2^30) = 1; 31 right shifts to 0; power-of-two test x & (x-1) = 0 checked for 1..4999. K&R 2e exercise 2-9 cited from memory, not opened; the sentence does not depend on it.

recall.question: x is a positive whole number and x & (x − 1) equals 0. What do you know about x?
options: x is a power of two
x is 1 less than a power of two
recall.why: x & (x − 1) clears only the lowest 1 bit. Getting 0 means that was the only 1 bit, so x is a power of two.
